claims.text: The proposed model is compared to the R.M.-Reader + Verifier, which is more complex and includes several components, yet the proposed model outperforms it by 0.7 in F1 score.
The proposed model is also compared to many existing MRC systems that extract answers by finding substrings in passages, highlighting its capability to predict unanswerable questions.
The model achieves state-of-the-art results on the SQuAD 2.0 dataset, outperforming the SAN baseline significantly in terms of EM and F1 scores.
